findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "duckduckgo" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get, get_news, get_images, get_videos, get_places · Public sink: get, get_places.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get, get_news, get_images, get_videos, get_places · Public sink: get, get_places

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
